title: ophrys holosericea subsp. lorenae
intro:
Ophrys holosericea subsp. lorenae, commonly known as the Orchid Bee Orchid, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the family Orchidaceae. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, digestive problems, and respiratory infections, due to its medicinal properties. The therapeutic actions of Ophrys holosericea subsp. lorenae include its antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which help to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and relieve congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
